text: `sufr list` prints each suffix from its start to the end of the text on every row, so without `--len` its output grows with the square of the text: at fc5db36, 1.9 GB for the 98 KB uniprot fixture, and a 10 MiB build did not finish in minutes. `--len N` caps each row at N bytes. To compare two builds of a large input, `cmp -l` the .sufr files and map the differing offsets onto the layout comment in `libsufr/src/format.rs`; `summarize` gives the suffix count as Len Suffixes.
